harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Deployed inventory-api as a systemd-managed service on node1 (AlmaLinux 9) with OOMScoreAdjust=-1000, protecting it from the kernel OOM killer. Verified via a real OOM event triggered by an unprotected memory-hog service (default oom_score_adj=0): the kernel OOM killer selected and killed the memory hog (PID 1422, oom_score_adj:0) per dmesg, while inventory-api (PID 1316, oom_score_adj:-1000) was never touched and kept answering HTTP 200 on /health and /inventory throughout. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured pre-restart boot_id and healthy baseline, issued systemctl reboot, polled until the node reconnected, confirmed the boot_id changed, and verified inventory-api auto-started (enabled, active, correct oom_score_adj=-1000) and served correct data again post-reboot.
actions_performed: Created /opt/inventory-api/app.py: Python HTTP service serving /health and /inventory JSON endpoints on port 8080
Created systemd unit inventory-api.service with Restart=always, OOMScoreAdjust=-1000, MemoryLow=100M; enabled and started it
Verified oom_score_adj=-1000 applied to the running inventory-api process
Created /opt/inventory-api/memhog.py and mem-hog.service (unprotected, oom_score_adj=0) to exercise OOM behavior
Captured healthy baseline (free memory, cleared dmesg) before triggering OOM
Started mem-hog.service and polled memory usage until the kernel triggered an OOM kill
Confirmed via dmesg that the kernel OOM killer selected the memory hog (pid 1422, oom_score_adj:0) and spared inventory-api (pid 1316, oom_score_adj:-1000)
Confirmed inventory-api kept serving HTTP 200 on /health and /inventory with the same PID throughout and after the OOM event
Disabled mem-hog.service and reset its failed state (test workload, not part of the standing deployment)
Captured pre-restart boot_id and confirmed inventory-api healthy/enabled
Issued systemctl reboot on node1, polled until reconnect
Confirmed boot_id changed from 4a743885-c59f-43ee-afde-ef96f7bea723 to 95222ed8-d543-4b36-8acf-b2ff1862e34b, proving an actual restart
Verified post-restart recovery: inventory-api auto-started, enabled, active, oom_score_adj=-1000 intact, serving correct JSON on both endpoints; mem-hog remained disabled/inactive as intended

evidence.requirement: inventory-api running as a managed (systemd) service
evidence.summary: inventory-api.service created, enabled, active; PID 1316 confirmed with oom_score_adj=-1000; endpoints return HTTP 200 with expected JSON

evidence.requirement: Memory-hungry process drives system out of memory
evidence.summary: Baseline captured (dmesg cleared, ~1.5GB free, no swap); mem-hog started unprotected; memory usage polled down to ~95Mi free before OOM triggered

evidence.requirement: Kernel OOM killer stops the memory hog, not inventory-api
evidence.summary: dmesg shows 'Out of memory: Killed process 1422 (python3) ... oom_score_adj:0' (the hog); systemd confirms mem-hog.service failed with result 'oom-kill'; inventory-api PID 1316 (oom_score_adj:-1000) untouched

evidence.requirement: inventory-api keeps serving during/after the OOM event
evidence.summary: Same PID (1316) still active; curl to /health and /inventory both return HTTP 200 with correct JSON immediately after the OOM kill

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence: healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id=4a743885-c59f-43ee-afde-ef96f7bea723, uptime, inventory-api active/enabled, HTTP 200 on /health

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence: restart acknowledgement returns before disconnect
evidence.summary: Backgrounded 'sleep 2 && systemctl reboot' so the exec call returned 'reboot scheduled' before the node went down

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence: changed boot identity proving actual restart
evidence.summary: Node became unreachable (connection timed out) during reboot, then reconnected with a new boot_id=95222ed8-d543-4b36-8acf-b2ff1862e34b, differing from the pre-restart boot_id

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence: post-restart recovery of required services and data
evidence.summary: inventory-api auto-started after reboot (active, enabled), oom_score_adj=-1000 preserved via the persisted unit file, and both endpoints returned correct JSON with HTTP 200; mem-hog remained disabled/inactive
